Class BattleManager

java.lang.Object
logic.BattleManager
public class BattleManager extends Object
Singleton that owns all living units on the battlefield and provides target-lookup queries used by unit AI every frame.

Player units (cats) and enemy units (dogs/bosses) are stored in separate lists. A unit attacks the opposite list. The singleton is reset between stages via clearAll().

    • findMultipleTargetsInRange

      public ArrayList<Unit> findMultipleTargetsInRange(Unit attacker)
      Returns all enemy units within the attacker's attack-range band.

      Towers are included even at 0 HP (so units keep attacking a dying tower). Distance is normally measured from the attacker's X to the target's rim position, with special-case overrides for TofuCat and Stickman/UFOCat pairs.

      Parameters:
      attacker - the unit performing the search
      Returns:
      list of valid targets; never null but may be empty

    • getEveryTargetOnBoard

      public ArrayList<Unit> getEveryTargetOnBoard()
      Returns the full enemy-unit list, including units at 0 HP (used by the cannon-wave sweep to hit everything on the board).
      Returns:
      the live enemy list (direct reference, do not modify)

      public Unit findSingleTargetInRange(Unit attacker)

      Returns:
